```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Loading Packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Loading Data

This data set includes variables for the focus outcome of a study, along with URE related variables. 
```{r}
data <- read.csv("MA_data.csv")
```

## Looking at data
```{r}
# Outcome; yes = math, no = reading
table(data$out_mathematics)

# Distribution of publication year
table(data$pub_year.x)

# Distribution of journal type
table(data$journal_cat.x)

# Distribution of stakeholder engagement
table(data$stake_engagement)

# Distribution of translated effect sizes
table(data$es_metrics)

# Distribution of inclusion of visualization
table(data$visualization)
```

## URE language types
```{r}
# Distribution of inclusion of scope text
table(data$text_type_scope)

# Distribution of inclusion of causes text
table(data$text_type_causes)

# Distribution of inclusion of feasibility text
table(data$text_type_feasibility)

# Distribution of inclusion of tactical text
table(data$text_type_tactical)

# Distribution of inclusion of mandated text
table(data$text_type_mandated)
```
## Target Audience
```{r}
# Target audience teachers
table(data$target_teacher)

# Target audience admin
table(data$target_admin)

# Target audience coaches
table(data$target_coach)

# Target audience policymakers
table(data$target_policy)

# Target audience other
table(data$target_other)

# Target audience unspecified
table(data$target_unspec)
```

## Text format
```{r}
# Implementation text
table(data$section)

# Text in list
table(data$list)
```
